description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called HomeScreen, which displays a grid of recipes fetched from a provider, with navigation to detail and form screens, and includes a floating action button to add new recipes.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a grid of recipes, with options to view details or add new recipes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, displaying either a loading indicator, an empty message, or a grid of recipe cards.
